A '''smuggler''' worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the smuggler captured the [[Mantellian Trooper]] [[Jendan Blyes]] and was ultimately stopped by the [[Alliance Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The smuggler appears in the [[2023]] Game Update 7.4 "Chains in the Dark" of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="TOR" /> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
